verdict: Leg 1 over 7c145212..9f988391 (Gate 5 batch 4): 0 BLOCKING, 1 MATERIAL, 6 MINOR. Every artifact the scorer scores from was replayed and matched byte-for-byte (the 15 records, the envelope, the compile-manifest, the harness, the census, the intake logs); all seven findings are in the notes' prose (the rule-2 framing, the census locations, the widening and naming disclosures, one misattributed quote); the folds edit only notes text and change no semantics, so no re-armed leg is owed; a fold touching a record, an envelope entry or a class name would owe one (none did).
